cases.query: Can I combine five different SKUs to qualify for the 10-unit tier?
Is shipping free when my order is exactly 500000 VND?

limitations: No live shop, customer, order, or social account was read or contacted.
Synthetic policy and product facts must not be used for customer-facing replies.
Literal must-include checks and citation validation are useful gates, not full human semantic review.
